• Dataset: Pick a CR_Dataset record. The dataset determines which root object and field paths are available downstream.
  • Fields: Select the columns to include. Use the search box to filter the long field list; click a field to add it.
  • Filters: Add WHERE-clause conditions. Operators adapt to the field type (e.g., picklist gets "is one of" multi-select).
  • Groupings: Group rows by one or more fields. Required for aggregations to work.
  • Aggregations: SUM/COUNT/AVG/MIN/MAX over numeric or date fields, scoped by the chosen groupings.
  • Live preview: The right pane runs the report against the first 250 rows on every step. Check column shape and filter behavior before saving.
  • Click Save Report — the button morphs to a green check on success.
